title: Chat stream stalls mid-response on long answers
author: @rokonkwo
body:
On answers past roughly 2k tokens the stream freezes: the typing indicator keeps spinning but no more tokens arrive. The run completes server-side (it shows up in the transcript log), the UI just never gets the tail.

This is what took us down during the July peak. Reproduced on 4.2.1 and on main; short answers are fine.
